text:
maya: Quick sync — we need a final plan for v2 API compatibility & deprecation. Customers are asking specifically about tool/function calling, structured outputs, and embeddings/rerank. Can we align on launch criteria, migration path, and timeline?

chris: From eng POV: principle is additive changes only. v2 should be opt-in. v1 stays supported for a deprecation window (proposal: 12 months GA -> EOL). For any breaking changes we require an explicit opt-in header.

alex: API question — do we prefer header-based versioning (e.g., `X-Redwood-API-Version: 2`) or explicit routes (`/v2/*`)? Header keeps URLs stable, route makes debugging easier.

sofia: DevEx: either approach is fine but docs + SDK helpers are critical. We'll ship a migration guide, example transforms, and a codemod for common SDK patterns. Need 2 weeks after API freeze to publish full migration materials.

chris: Engineering leans header-first. Implementation sketch: routing checks `X-Redwood-API-Version` then picks v2 behavior; if absent, serve v1 for now. Also add a warning header for v1 responses after GA to nudge customers. Example header we can add later:

```http
X-Redwood-API-Version: 1
X-Redwood-Warning: v1 will be deprecated in 11 months
```

raj: CS notes — we have 8 paying customers asking for structured outputs + better function/tool calling. They want a beta program and ~6 months to migrate. Would appreciate extended EOL support per-customer.

maya: My proposal: v2 GA -> default opt-in available immediately via header. Then 12-month public deprecation for v1 core endpoints (completions, chat, embeddings, rerank). For beta / enterprise customers we can negotiate extended windows (up to 18 months) with support. Launch criteria:
- Performance parity: median latency regression <20% vs v1 for same model profile
- Embeddings compatibility: vector dims unchanged or clear migration path
- SDK coverage: official clients with migration helpers for Python/JS/Go
- Docs & migration guide published + codemod
- Telemetry to detect v1 usage and warn customers

leah: Security note — private/on-prem deployments can't be forced to add headers. For Private customers we must ship a compatibility toggle in the control plane and include KMS/HSM verification in the launch checklist.

chris: On function/tool calling — v2 will provide structured output schema validation and richer function return types. We'll build a compatibility shim to map common v1 outputs to the new schema when possible; document edge cases.

alex: Rerank & embeddings detail: if model upgrade changes embedding dimension, we'll treat it as a separate embedding-versioned endpoint (e.g., `embeddings?v=2`). Provide a migration script to re-index corpora.

sofia: Draft launch checklist (high level):
- API runtime: header routing + fallback shim implemented
- Docs: migration guide + examples for chat/completions/tool-calling/structured-output
- SDKs: v2 client with opt-in flag + codemod CLI
- Telemetry: count v1 vs v2 calls, emit warnings, surface in Console
- Beta cohort: onboard 8 customers, run migration tests
- Deprecation comms: email, dashboard banner, changelog, public deprecation page

maya: Action items before next review (next Tue):
- chris: prototype header routing + warning header by Fri (1742170000)
- alex: spec route-to-header mapping and fallback semantics, and document query param options
- sofia: start migration guide draft and codemod outline
- raj: confirm beta customer list and migration timelines
- leah: list security checks for Private deployments (KMS, audit logs)

ops-bot: Reminder — schedule product announcement and infra rollout window for v2. Keep downtime <= 2 hours. :calendar: 

chris: Also propose we add a gradual warning cadence: 30 days after GA start sending `X-Redwood-Warning` on v1 responses, increasing prominence over time. Keep team updated on telemetry so we can decide EOL.

maya: OK — this captures what we need. I'll consolidate into a short spec and share with eng-sre + support for feedback. If any objections to the 12-month public EOL, call it out here.

raj: +1 from CS. We'll prepare customer comms templates once spec is up.

sofia: I'll add migration examples for: simple prompt -> structured JSON, tool-calling with function schema changes, and embeddings migration steps.

chris: Noted. We'll also add a server-side `compat-mode` flag for Private customers so they can toggle behavior during migration.

maya: Great, thanks everyone. Follow-ups in a PR later today.
